Rule 125

This example rule lists a few things to check before overtaking, and links to another rule for further reading.

  • checking your mirrors regularly
  • signalling in good time

See also Rule 98 for a related rule in this fixture.

Rule 126

Stopping distances. Drive at a speed that will allow you to stop well within the distance you can see to be clear. Allow at least a two-second gap.
